description: This file defines a Kotlin class `SharePasswordDialogFragment` which provides a dialog interface for users to input or update passwords when sharing files or folders in an Android app. It manages user interactions such as entering passwords, skipping, or cancelling, and applies branding styles to UI elements.

classes.name: SharePasswordDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment allowing users to input or update the password for sharing a file or folder. It manages UI interactions, branding application, and communicates the password setup back via a listener interface.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart lifecycle method to set a click listener on the positive button, handling the password input and trigger sharing or setting the password.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides onResume to show the keyboard for the password input field.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and initializes the dialog with layout, buttons, and titles, based on input arguments.

methods.name: callSetPassword
methods.description: Reads the entered password and invokes the appropriate listener callback to share the file or set the password.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the binding when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to dialog components based on the provided color.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of the dialog with various parameters (note, share, createShare, askForPassword).
